map.逐字标注平仄，辅助格律诗校验（基于常用字库，未收录字标记为“？”）: Annotate the tone (level/oblique) of each character to aid classical-poem validation (based on a common-character dictionary; unlisted characters are marked "?").
map.Marks the level (平) or oblique (仄) tone: Marks the level (ping) or oblique (ze) tone of every character against a built-in dictionary so you can check a classical poem against the expected tonal pattern.
map.逐字判定平仄：把每句按字拆开，命中内置平声字库（198 字）标「平」、命中仄声字: Judge the tone character by character: split each line into characters, mark "ping" (level) if in the built-in level-tone dictionary (198 chars), "ze" (oblique) if in the oblique dictionary (2086 chars), or "?" if in neither, then output the per-character tone string line by line for self-check against the tonal pattern. Polyphonic and archaic entering-tone characters are for reference only; defer to an authoritative rhyme book.
map.床前明月光\n疑是地上霜\n举头望明月\n低头思故乡:
Before my bed the bright moonlight glows,
I wonder if it's frost upon the ground.
I raise my head to gaze at the moon,
I bow my head and think of home.
map.平仄判断基于内置常用字库，多音字可能显示单一结果: Tone judgment is based on a built-in common-character dictionary; polyphonic characters may show a single result.
map.计算结果仅供参考，请以权威韵书为准: Results are for reference only; please defer to an authoritative rhyme book.
map.写完绝句或律诗后，逐字核对平仄是否合谱，重点看二四六字位。: After writing a quatrain or regulated verse, check each character against the tonal pattern, focusing on the even-numbered positions.
map.诗词教学：直观展示平仄交替与「一三五不论」的位置差异。: Teaching poetry: show tone alternation and why the first, third and fifth positions are flexible.
map.读诗时标注生僻字与多音字的平仄归属，减少翻查韵书。: Mark the tones of rare and polyphonic characters while reading, reducing rhyme-book lookups.
map.输入两行五言诗句 → 按句拆成单字并给出平 / 仄 / ？ 徽章 → 输出逐字平: Enter two five-character lines → split them into characters and mark each level, oblique or unknown → output a per-character tone string and compare the even positions with the metrical pattern
map.多音字和古入声字怎么判？: How are polyphonic and archaic entering-tone characters handled?
map.内置字库对多音字只给单一结果，古入声字与现代普通话读音可能不同；结果仅供参考，最: The built-in dictionary gives one reading per polyphonic character, and archaic entering tones may differ from modern Mandarin. Results are indicative only; defer to an authoritative rhyme book.
map.为什么有的字显示「？」？: Why do some characters show a question mark?
map.该字未收录在内置常用平声 / 仄声字库中，工具不会猜测其平仄；请查韵书后自行判断: That character is not in the built-in level / oblique dictionary, so the tool does not guess its tone. Check a rhyme book and decide yourself.
map.能替代韵书或格律谱吗？: Can it replace a rhyme book or metrical pattern?
map.不能。本工具只按内置字库逐字标注，不判断拗救、押韵与对仗；正式创作请对照格律谱与: No. It only marks tones from the built-in dictionary and does not judge tonal rescues, rhyming or antithesis. For serious writing, consult a metrical pattern and an authoritative rhyme book.
map.逐字标注格律诗的平仄：把输入诗句按字拆开，与内置的常用平声 / 仄声字库比对，命: Annotate the level/oblique tones of a classical poem character by character: split the input lines into characters, compare against the built-in common level-tone / oblique-tone dictionaries, mark "ping" (level) or "ze" (oblique) on a hit or "?" if unlisted, then output the tone string line by line for self-check against the tonal pattern.
map.逐字平仄标注，平 / 仄 / 未收录三态着色: Per-character tone annotation with three-state coloring: level / oblique / unlisted.
map.按句分行输出，句序与原诗一一对应: Output line by line, with line order matching the original poem.
map.内置平声 198 字、仄声 2086 字常用字库，无需联网查韵书: Built-in dictionaries of 198 level-tone and 2086 oblique-tone common characters—no internet needed to look up a rhyme book.
map.支持五言、七言及任意字数的自由输入: Supports five-character, seven-character, and free-form input of any length.
map.格律诗自查：写完绝句 / 律诗后核对每字平仄是否合谱: Self-check for regulated verse: after writing a quatrain / octave, verify each character's tone against the pattern.
map.教学演示：直观展示平仄交替与「一三五不论」的位置差异: Teaching demo: visually show tone alternation and the positional difference of the "first-third-fifth flexible" rule.
map.读诗辅助：标注生僻字的平仄归属，降低查韵书成本: Reading aid: mark the tone of rare characters to reduce the cost of consulting rhyme books.
map.说明：平仄依据常用字库判定，多音字与古入声字仅作参考，请以权威韵书为准。: Note: tone patterns are judged from a common character database; polyphonic characters and ancient entering-tone characters are for reference only, so consult an authoritative rhyme dictionary.
map.按换行切分为句、逐句去空白与标点后拆成单字；每字先查平声字库命中则标「平」，否则: Split into sentences by newlines, strip whitespace and punctuation from each sentence and split it into single characters; for each character check the level-tone dictionary first and mark it level if found, otherwise check the oblique-tone dictionary and mark it oblique, and mark not-listed (shown as ?) when neither contains it; each sentence outputs character badges with tone marks, with a note that polyphonic and old entering-tone characters are for reference only
map.逐字判定平仄：把每句按字拆开，命中内置平声字库（约 170 字）标「平」、命中仄: Per-character tone judgement: split each sentence into characters, mark level tones on a hit in the built-in level-tone dictionary (about 170 characters), oblique tones on a hit in the oblique-tone dictionary (about 2000 characters), and ? when neither contains it, then output the per-character tone string line by line so you can self-check against a metrical pattern. Polyphonic and old entering-tone characters are for reference only; the authoritative rhyme book prevails.
map.内置平声约 170 字、仄声约 2000 字常用字库，无需联网查韵书: Built-in dictionaries of about 170 common level-tone and about 2000 oblique-tone characters, no online rhyme book needed
